paragraphs.text: The Sea of Almaaz is a body of water in the western Terisian Isles .

The Sea of Almaaz is a narrow sea separating the large islands of Gulmany and Almaaz from each other. The sea connects to the Sea of Laments in the east, the Lat-Nam Straits in the southwest, and the Ilesemare Sea in the northwest.

The Sea of Almaaz came into being during the Thaw when the meltwater that had been locked into the four glaciers of Terisiare started to rush out. The Flooding of Terisiare occurred over several decades, and the water pooled across the central parts of the continent, separating it into smaller isles that became known as the Terisian Isles .
The Sea of Almaaz covers what used to be the northern borders of Almaaz , Terisia City and part of the Great Desert , running almost to the submerged ruins of Sarinth .
